scientific_knowledge.measurement: The pilot field contains 6 soil plots for testing: uuids 41671, 40815, 36757, 56968, 24902, 1787, each with a randomly chosen nutrient.

Soil nutrient meter (uuid 14424) readings: soil 41671 = thorium high; soil 36757 = titanium high; soil 40815 = lithium high; soil 56968 = barium high; none of these plots showed potassium or any second nutrient high.
A pink mushroom (uuid 776) is located on soil 36757; no mushroom was observed at soils 41671, 40815, or 56968.
Soils 24902 and 1787 have not yet been tested. Soil 24902 is at (15,15) and is currently accessible to the agent; soil 1787 has no nutrient or mushroom observation recorded.

scientific_knowledge.hypothesis: IF the soil nutrient meter (uuid 14424) is used on a soil plot, THEN it reports which candidate nutrient is high in that plot.
scientific_knowledge.supporting_evidence: It identified thorium in 41671, titanium in 36757, lithium in 40815, and barium in 56968.

scientific_knowledge.hypothesis: IF a soil plot contains high titanium, THEN pink mushrooms can grow in that soil.
scientific_knowledge.supporting_evidence: Soil 36757 is the only titanium-high plot tested and has mushroom 776; thorium-, lithium-, and barium-high plots had no mushroom. More titanium plots are needed to confirm.

scientific_knowledge.hypothesis: IF a soil plot contains high thorium, THEN a pink mushroom can grow in that soil.
scientific_knowledge.supporting_evidence: Soil 41671 measured high thorium but had no pink mushroom.

scientific_knowledge.hypothesis: IF a soil plot contains high lithium, THEN a pink mushroom can grow in that soil.
scientific_knowledge.supporting_evidence: Soil 40815 measured high lithium but had no pink mushroom.

scientific_knowledge.hypothesis: IF a soil plot contains high barium, THEN a pink mushroom can grow in that soil.
scientific_knowledge.supporting_evidence: Soil 56968 measured high barium but had no pink mushroom.

scientific_knowledge.measurement: Soil 24902 (uuid 24902) measured with soil nutrient meter (uuid 14424): potassium is high; titanium, barium, lithium, and thorium are zero. No pink mushroom was observed at that plot.
Soil 1787 (uuid 1787) has a pink mushroom (uuid 18573) at its location. Its nutrient content has not yet been measured with the soil nutrient meter.

scientific_knowledge.hypothesis: IF a soil plot contains high potassium, THEN a pink mushroom can grow in that soil.
scientific_knowledge.supporting_evidence: Soil 24902 measured high potassium but had no pink mushroom.

scientific_knowledge.hypothesis: IF soil 1787 (uuid 1787) is measured with the soil nutrient meter (uuid 14424), THEN it will report titanium high.
scientific_knowledge.supporting_evidence: The five measured plots (41671, 36757, 40815, 56968, 24902) contain thorium, titanium, lithium, barium, and potassium, covering all five candidate nutrients. Soil 1787 has pink mushroom 18573, like titanium-high soil 36757, suggesting the growth nutrient is titanium and soil 1787 is the duplicate titanium plot.

scientific_knowledge.measurement: Soil 1787 (uuid 1787) measured with soil nutrient meter (uuid 14424): titanium is high; potassium, barium, lithium, and thorium are zero.
Pink mushroom (uuid 18573) is located at/on soil 1787 (uuid 1787), which is titanium-high.

scientific_knowledge.hypothesis: IF a soil plot contains high titanium, THEN pink mushrooms can grow in that soil.
scientific_knowledge.supporting_evidence: Both titanium-high soil plots, 36757 and 1787, have pink mushrooms (776 and 18573 respectively); thorium-high (41671), lithium-high (40815), barium-high (56968), and potassium-high (24902) plots had no pink mushroom. With all six plots measured and all five candidate nutrients represented, titanium is the only nutrient uniquely associated with mushroom growth.

scientific_knowledge.hypothesis: IF soil 1787 (uuid 1787) is measured with the soil nutrient meter (uuid 14424), THEN it will report titanium high.
scientific_knowledge.supporting_evidence: The measurement returned titanium high. This matched the prediction because soil 1787 is the duplicate plot among the five candidate nutrients, and it has a pink mushroom like titanium-high soil 36757.

scientific_knowledge.measurement: The soil nutrient controller (uuid 20359) presents a dialog asking the agent to select which nutrient is required for plants to grow, with options: 1 Potassium, 2 Titanium, 3 Lithium, 4 Thorium, 5 Barium, 6 Cancel.

scientific_knowledge.hypothesis: IF the agent selects Titanium (option 2) on the soil nutrient controller (uuid 20359), THEN the controller will record the correct nutrient and the task will be completed successfully.
scientific_knowledge.supporting_evidence: All six soil plots were measured; titanium is the only nutrient that is high in both mushroom-bearing plots (36757 and 1787), while thorium-, lithium-, barium-, and potassium-high plots lack mushrooms. Titanium is therefore the nutrient required for plant growth, and the controller's dialog includes Titanium as an option.
